text:
ira: short pitch 
I want a pointer-first rollout metadata shape that stays tiny for Dedicated/Private SDKs and pushes policy logic to telemetry/runtime. minimal fields: cohorts, lease_str, alert_policy_refs, fallback_model, allow_auto_unpin, audit_ref.

samir: sounds promising. can you paste a micro example so we can see the exact surface?

ira: sure (compact example):
```json
{ "cohorts": ["canary:5","eu:30"], "cohort_priority": "canary,eu,global", "lease_str": "ttl=3600;hb=true", "alert_policy_refs": ["ap-77"], "allow_auto_unpin": "false", "fallback_model": "redwood/gptx-7b@v1", "audit_ref": "s3://rollout-audits/2026/3951239876.json" }
```

claire: +1 to keeping shapes compact. two operational asks: 1) explicit precedence table (customer_pin > tenant_override > rollout) and 2) a grace/backoff window for soft_unpin so we don't flip on transient alerts.

marta: for auto_unpin semantics please avoid embedding thresholds. have the metadata reference alert_policy ids only and a boolean allow_auto_unpin. telemetry owns thresholds and lookback windows. runtime owns the backoff.

samir: agree. also add a small "reconcile_hint_secs" so dedicated clusters know how long to wait before asserting convergence (default 600). helps reduce churn during global rebalances.

ops-bot: NOTICE: rollout request accepted by ira at 3951239876 for model redwood/gptx-7b@v1. cohorts: canary(5%), eu(30%).

ira: good feedback. let's keep audit payloads out of primary metadata. audit_ref should point to an immutable artifact that contains: rollout_id, model_ref, trigger_alerts, observed_metrics_ref, previous_cohorts, chosen_fallback, timestamp, operator.

claire: SDK note: prefer lease_str as a short key=value string so air-gapped SDKs don't break on nested objects. server will canonicalize. also prefer booleans as strings ("true"/"false") for max compatibility.

marta: operational rule: if allow_auto_unpin=true then soft_unpin should be the default behavior (decay pct using backoff_multiplier). hard_unpin must be an explicit operator action. record every auto decision to the audit store and emit an audit_ref.

samir: validation rules: server rejects cohort names with spaces, enforces lowercasing, and rejects writes where co-located cohort pct > 100. also reject ensemble pins that fail compatibility checks (tokenizer, I/O contract) with a helpful error pointer.

ira: next steps - I'll update the RFC appendix with the compact shape, precedence table, and example CLI snippets. claire/marta/samir: volunteer to add SDK tests, runbook snippets, and audit schema?

claire: I'll add SDK roundtrip tests and serialization examples for Dedicated/private.

marta: I'll draft the ops runbook for soft_unpin vs manual rollback and the emergency kill switch.

samir: I'll add unit tests for resolver precedence, lease expiry, and write server-side validation rules.

ira: thanks all. I'll open the PR tonight and tag you. :thumbsup:
